plotEn:
In 1858, Winifred Notty arrives at the remote gothic manor, Ensor House, to be the governess to the Pounds's two children, Drusilla and Andrew. Her first outing with the pair culminates in Winifred bludgeoning a resting deer to death and threatening Andrew when he informs his mother about the events. Winifred is seeking to escape her past, but the gardener quickly confronts her about her previous charges' disappearances in an attempt to blackmail her. When she meets the gardener that night, she murders him with an axe and feeds his remains to the estate's pigs.
To further cover up the killing of the gardener, she befriends the estate's nurse, Sue Lamb. Despite her wishes to become a part of the Pounds family, her erratic behavior causes the family and employees to be unsettled--including the carving of Mr. Pounds's family members' portraits. During a gathering of other wealthy members in the area, an Egyptian mummy is presented and unraveled to the adults' amusement. Drusilla draws pornographic caricatures of the guests, including her father, performing necrophiliac acts on the mummy. Enraged, Mr. Pounds shoots the notebook containing the drawings while Drusilla is holding it. Drusilla feels no regrets about her actions, only that the drawings were not of a better quality, causing Winifred to wonder if Drusilla's "darkness" was present at her birth, as was hers, or came about upon her arrival at the estate.
